verdict.rationale: Gecko documents an official MCP/AI-tools connection that lets a coding agent list scans, pull full vulnerability evidence and triage findings. Separately, PR checks scan changes and post pass/fail gates with a fail-on-severity threshold before merge. However, the agent integration is documented as reading and triaging findings, not as the agent triggering a scan of its own freshly generated code before commit. Missing for 10: documented agent-initiated scanning of AI-generated code pre-commit or pre-PR, an end-to-end agent workflow guide, and independent hands-on corroboration of the agent integration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can wire the scanner into my coding agent so AI-generated code is scanned for issues before it lands

citations.quote: Connect it to an AI tool and the tool can list your repositories and scans, pull full vulnerability evidence (proof of concept, call chain, patch diff), triage findings, and file tickets.
